prompt:
A space vehicle of total mass 960 kg travels in deep space at a steady velocity of 35.0 m s^-1 along the positive x-axis. An explosive bolt releases a science probe of mass 160 kg. Immediately after separation, the science probe moves forward at 47.0 m s^-1 along the positive x-axis.
(a) State the mass of the remaining service module. [1]
(b) Calculate the total momentum of the space vehicle before separation. [1]
(c) Calculate the velocity of the service module immediately after separation. [2]
hints: Total momentum before separation equals sum of momenta of probe and service module.
solution:
(a) Mass of service module = 960 kg - 160 kg = 800 kg.
(b) Total initial momentum = 960 kg x 35.0 m s^-1 = 33600 kg m s^-1 (3.36 x 10^4 kg m s^-1).
(c) By conservation of linear momentum:
33600 kg m s^-1 = (160 kg x 47.0 m s^-1) + (800 kg x v_module)
33600 = 7520 + 800 v_module
800 v_module = 26080
v_module = +32.6 m s^-1 in the positive x-direction.
teacher_walkthrough: Step 3: (c) p_probe = 160 x 47.0 = 7520 kg m s^-1.
Step 5: v_module = 26080 / 800 = 32.6 m s^-1 in the positive x-direction.

mark_scheme.criterion: 33600 kg m s^-1 (accept 3.36 x 10^4 kg m s^-1)
32.6 m s^-1 in the positive x-direction
